belt_drive.name: Two wheels / one belt / 2:1
belt_drive.label: Two wheels / one belt / 2:1
belt_drive.description: Turn either of two unequal wheels linked by a visible open belt. One large-wheel turn produces two small-wheel turns in the same direction. Pink spokes and travelling belt witnesses expose the ratio. Ideal no-slip kinematics, not a force or tension simulation.
belt_drive.qfep_connection: A shared belt displacement constrains unequal circles to different angular speeds. One cause produces two visibly different rotations; appearance is tied to a declared geometric assumption.
